title: Public classical attacks: exact LLL reducedness, polynomial-space RREF and determinant-gap counterfamily

theorems.name: Sharp Free-Column Support Lower Bound and Column-Pair Immunity
theorems.statement: For any planted ternary vector u in {-1, 0, 1}^n \ {0} in ker(H mod q) with total Hamming support s = ||u||_1 = ||u||_2^2 and pivot/free partition (P, F) (|P| = m, |F| = n - m), the free-column support s_F = |supp(u) cap F| satisfies max(1, s - m) <= s_F <= min(s, n - m). Whenever s >= 3 and ker(H mod q) contains no nonzero non-parallel vector of squared Euclidean norm <= 2, sparse_column_attack returns NO_UNIT_OR_COLUMN_PAIR_RELATION.

theorems.name: Conditional (delta,eta)-LLL bound, with independently verified reducedness
theorems.statement: For a verified (delta,eta)-reduced basis and alpha=1/(delta-eta^2), ||b_1||^2 <= alpha^(n-1)||u||^2 for every nonzero lattice u. Recovery of primitive +/-u from this bound additionally requires lambda2>alpha^((n-1)/2)||u||. No lambda2 premise or monotone LLL success is inferred from determinant growth.

theorems.name: Projective free-coordinate enumeration without an exponential table
theorems.statement: Enumerate (3^(n-m)-1)/2 sign-canonical free assignments and reconstruct pivots from public RREF. Additional working storage is O(m*(n-m)+n) integer slots, not constant; bit cost depends on log q. Fewer assignment states than ambient MITM does not by itself certify wall-time dominance.

withdrawn_claims: determinant growth proves increasing lambda2 gap or LLL success
RREF enumeration uses O(1) working memory
finite recovery validates asymptotic LLL isolation
